title: Bulgarian Honey Cookies
hookLine: Global-inspired bulgarian honey cookies with 11 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Sift & Whisk Dry Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat oven to 350 F. Line 2-3 baking sheets with parchment paper. In a bowl, combine flour, salt, cinnamon and baking soda. Sifting aerates the dry ingredients and removes any stubborn cocoa or flour lumps so the finished crumb bakes up light and even. Incorporate {m53493_1}, {m53493_2}, {m53493_3}, and {m53493_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure eggs first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: In the bowl of a stand mixer, fitted with the paddle attachment, beat together eggs and powdered sugar for3 minutes. Add vanilla extract and honey. Mix to combine, then add oil. Add the flour mixture in two increments and beat to incorporate. Let the dough rest for 5-10 minutes. Incorporate {m53493_5}, {m53493_6}, {m53493_7}, {m53493_8}, {m53493_9}, {m53493_10}, and {m53493_11} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: Shape 2 tbsp balls, place on baking sheets and press flat. Bake for 12-15 minutes, until golden. Let the cookies cool down completely. Melt white and semi-sweet chocolate separately with 1 tbsp vegetable oil each.

steps.title: Dip & Coat Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Dip cookies halfway into chocolate. Let it set. Keep in a air tight container or wrapped in cellophane bags for up to 2 weeks in room temperature or refrigerated.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 33 mins!
